verdict.rationale: The pack shows Zulip has a REST API (sending messages, bots framework, integrations) but nowhere claims or demonstrates that the API mirrors every UI capability (e.g., topic/channel management, search filters, exports) 1:1. Probes for OpenAPI/spec discovery also failed (404s), suggesting no easily verifiable full API surface. missing for 10: explicit API parity documentation, OpenAPI spec, evidence that channel/topic/search/export UI actions are all API-accessible.
